page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by 64.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 2.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1435.39 and a multi-core score of 30631.79. In memory-intensive operations, it achieves a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1704.01 GB/sec, which drops to 104.96 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. The CPU features AVX-512 and AVX512_VNNI instructions, enabling efficient execution of vector and neural network operations, as reflected in its 7B LLM inference prompt processing speed of 46.11 tokens/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfc6.8xlarge offers a balanced profile for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local SSD storage. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio minimizes memory overhead costs while maximizing raw processing power. This makes the instance highly suitable for high-throughput web serving, software compilation, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, as demonstrated by its static web serving throughput of 20.59 GB/sec and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression rate of 139.27 GB/sec.
